title: Doc Test Visibility
goal: Expose library functions properly so doc tests pass.

source.attribution: adapted from Day 4 Afternoon: Documentation Tests

hints: Doc tests compile as external consumers of your module or crate.
Select the visibility keyword that makes an item accessible outside its parent module.
explanation: Documentation tests treat library code as external callers, requiring full `pub` visibility on items inside parent modules. Omitted visibility or `pub(self)` restricts access to `math` and produces compiler error `E0603` when called from outside `math`. Comparing `square(4)` to `0` fails assertion evaluation, and passing a string produces `E0308` type mismatch.
